title: The 10 Best Cordless Hedge Trimmers
subtitle: Battery-powered hedge trimmers for shrubs and hedges, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless hedge trimmer shapes shrubs and hedges with no cord to cut and no engine to start. We ranked 10 best-sellers from BLACK+DECKER, WORX, EGO, Greenworks, CRAFTSMAN and budget brands on rating, review volume and features (a 22-inch or longer blade, a battery in the box, 3/4-inch or bigger cut capacity and dual-action blades).
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

avoid.name: 2-in-1 600W 21V Cordless Hedge Trimmer, Green
avoid.flag: No blade length or cut capacity listed; 600 W claim
avoid.verdict: A $20 handheld shear sold as a hedge trimmer, with no blade length or cutting capacity anywhere in the listing.
reasons: The listing never states the blade length or the thickest branch it can cut, the two numbers that decide what a hedge trimmer can handle.
It claims a '600W high power motor' on a small 21V handheld with no amp or runtime figure to back it.
The model number (LLJFXIN260602) and part number (llj2255654) don't match, and nothing ties the product to a traceable maker. The BLACK+DECKER LHT2220 states 22 in and 3/4 in.

buyers_guide.q: What blade length do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 18 to 20 inches for small shrubs and tight spots. 22 inches covers most hedges. 24 to 26 inches makes long, flat runs faster but adds weight.
The thickest branch the blades can cut. 5/8 to 3/4 inch handles yearly trimming; overgrown hedges need 1 inch or more, like the EGO HT2601 or Greenworks HT2002.
Both blades move in opposite directions, which cuts faster and vibrates less than a single moving blade. Nearly every trimmer here is dual-action.

buyers_guide.q: Hedge trimmer or pole hedge trimmer?
buyers_guide.a: For hedges taller than you can comfortably reach, a pole hedge trimmer or an attachment on a pole saw saves using a ladder.

buyers_guide.q: How do I keep the blades working?
buyers_guide.a: Wipe off sap and spray a lubricant after each use. Sharp, clean blades cut cleaner and drain the battery less.
